source.pts_provenance: OpenCV FFmpeg CAP_PROP_POS_MSEC after decoded frame

mapping.disclaimer: Approximate known-diameter normalization of image-plane coordinates, not calibrated depth, camera intrinsics, metric pose ground truth or 6D recovery. A single local isotropic scale ignores perspective, lens distortion, object-height parallax and nonuniform pixel scale across the tabletop. World axes and origin are synthetic.
mapping.diameter_definition: geometric mean of visible bearing ellipse axes
mapping.terminal_offset: Terminal ring minus terminal bearing with terminal local scale; excludes camera shake

boundary_policy: Bounded candidate endpoints only; no velocity/action differences across edited cuts
